title: Integrated multi-level transcriptomic and bioinformatics analysis identifies lipid metabolism-ubiquitination signatures and reveals ATG5, ASB4, LDLR, and CD36 as Candidate biomarkers in insulin resistance.
authors: Chen, Jicui; Wu, Gang; Shi, Wei; Ma, Xianjun
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习筛选胰岛素抵抗相关脂代谢-泛素化标志基因，虽预测了上游转录因子调控网络，但核心是湿实验验证和生物标志物发现，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Insulin resistance (IR) is the core pathological basis of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). This study aimed to identify core lipid metabolism-ubiquitination-related feature genes in IR. Integrative transcriptomic and functional analysis screened differential genes via multiple machine learning models. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), regulatory network prediction, and immune infiltration analysis were performed. C2C12 IR models were constructed, and ATG5 was knocked down to detect glucose-lipid metabolism, inflammation, and insulin signaling. Results showed that four feature genes were identified: Good genes Ankyrin Repeat And SOCS Box Containing 4 (ASB4)/ Low Density Lipoprotein Receptor (LDLR) and Bad genes ATG5/ CD36 molecule (CD36 blood group) (CD36). They were enriched in metabolism/inflammation pathways consistent with IR phenotypes. Regulatory network analysis predicted potential upstream microRNAs (miRNAs) and transcription factors (TFs) modulating these feature genes. IR/diabetes groups had lower ImmuneScores vs. insulin-sensitive groups. ATG5 was upregulated in IR models. Its knockdown inhibited autophagy, improved glucose and lipid metabolism, decreased inflammatory cytokines, and exerted no influence on cell viability. In conclusion, ASB4, LDLR, ATG5, and CD36 are potential IR biomarkers. ATG5 regulates IR via autophagy, insulin signaling, and metabolism, serving as a therapeutic target for metabolic diseases.
abstract_zh: 胰岛素抵抗（IR）是2型糖尿病（T2DM）的核心病理基础。本研究旨在识别IR中脂质代谢-泛素化相关的核心特征基因。通过整合转录组学和功能分析，利用多种机器学习模型筛选差异基因。进行了基因集富集分析（GSEA）、调控网络预测和免疫浸润分析。构建了C2C12 IR模型，并敲低ATG5以检测糖脂代谢、炎症和胰岛素信号传导。结果显示，鉴定出四个特征基因：良好基因锚蛋白重复和SOCS盒蛋白4（ASB4）/低密度脂蛋白受体（LDLR）以及不良基因ATG5/ CD36分子（CD36血型）（CD36）。它们富集在与IR表型一致的代谢/炎症通路中。调控网络分析预测了可能调节这些特征基因的上游微小RNA（miRNAs）和转录因子（TFs）。IR/糖尿病组的免疫评分低于胰岛素敏感组。ATG5在IR模型中上调。其敲低抑制了自噬，改善了糖脂代谢，减少了炎症细胞因子，且对细胞活力无影响。总之，ASB4、LDLR、ATG5和CD36是潜在的IR生物标志物。ATG5通过自噬、胰岛素信号传导和代谢调节IR，作为代谢性疾病的治疗靶点。
